evidence_level: development only; the five evaluation layouts were observed in v2
mechanism_question: Does position-shared, action-conditioned raw-pixel fragment probability memory transfer a direct policy to structurally different Sokoban layouts better than exact full-frame memory under identical experience?

fixed_scaffolding.decision: support-weighted Beta posterior evidence across raw fragments and fixed horizons, multiplied by raw-change posterior; deterministic argmax

same_experience.retention_rule: all successful episodes plus the first 128 failed episodes per level

primary_metric: total frozen successes over 5 development-transfer layouts x 32 episodes
next_stage_rule: Only a passed development gate permits creation and one-time execution of a new permanent held-out level pack. A failed gate is retained without threshold changes.
